sentences.text: This animal belongs to the suborder Thalattosuchia, a group of marine crocodyliforms.
When first examined, the skull bones were arranged more like those of a crocodyliform than a pterosaur.
The genus was named by Seeley in 1880.
Researchers argue that the holotype specimen lacked good autapomorphies, leading to the classification of the genus Rhamphocephalus as a nomen dubium.
There are 10 recorded fossil occurrences of Rhamphocephalus in the Paleobiology Database.
Fossils date from 168.2 to 154.8 million years ago, covering the Bathonian to Oxfordian stages.

Andres (2021) suggests resurrecting the genus name Dolicorhamphus for species formerly assigned to Rhamphocephalus, finding them to belong to a monophyletic pterosaur genus closely related to Klobiodon.
